title: Add autonomy-next help and flag validation
summary: autonomy-next has no --help output and accepts unknown flags, which makes autonomous runs harder to resume and debug. Add explicit usage output, reject unknown flags with a non-zero exit, and keep --json/--seed semantics stable.
expectedFailureModes: Unknown flags are silently ignored, causing operators to believe a mode was enabled when it was not.
autonomy-next output changes without updating docs, so sessions still stall on the selector.
Help or error paths regress and break deterministic automation wrappers.
nextAction: Teach autonomy-next to handle --help/-h and unknown flags consistently, then update autonomy task docs to reflect the supported CLI surface.
